verdict.rationale: Formant documents automated incident detection and alerts, says orchestration "dispatches help the moment something looks wrong," keeps intervention records, and offers operator teleoperation, which together cover the core of an escalate-to-human loop. Nothing in the evidence describes a dedicated intervention queue, triaging autonomy failures into it, or a handback-of-control step. missing for 10: an explicit human intervention queue, routing of autonomy failures into that queue, a documented resolve-and-handback-to-autonomy flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can route autonomy failures to a human intervention queue where an operator resolves and hands back control
